roadEnds: The top of the entrance tunnel

cards.subject: The Stonemaul caves
lines: The Dragonmurk was not hers. She drove the Stonemaul ogres out of it to get somewhere to raise her children.
The tunnel, the cavern and both egg chambers are a repossessed ogre home with a nest built into it.

cards.subject: One boss and no trash
lines: The only other things in the whole instance are her whelps and her guards, and both belong to the fight.
Forty people could zone in and be pulling inside a minute.
Nothing else in vanilla worked like that.

cards.subject: You cannot get in without the amulet
lines: Neither faction's chain is a fetch quest. The Alliance side is sixteen quests and runs through two Blackrock Depths trips escorting Marshal Windsor.
The Horde side is twelve, and ends in a full raid clear of Upper Blackrock Spire for a general's blood.

cards.subject: Four dragons on four continents
lines: The Horde chain sends you to kill an elite dragon outside the Caverns of Time, another in a Winterspring cave, a third wandering the Swamp of Sorrows, and a fourth at Grim Batol.
Every one of them is a raid kill.
That is the middle of the key quest, not the end of it.

cards.subject: You have to pretend to be a dragon
lines: Mid-chain a Horde player puts on an amulet that turns them into a dragonspawn, and only then can walk into his den and hold a conversation instead of a fight.
Her key is earned by disguising yourself as one of her kind.
She was, at that moment, disguised as one of yours.

cards.subject: She talks to a raid like staff
lines: "How fortuitous. Usually, I must leave my lair in order to feed."
"This meaningless exertion bores me. I'll incinerate you all from above!"
And when she kills somebody: "Learn your place, mortal!"

cards.subject: The raid is happening in a nursery
lines: The two chambers off the main cavern hold her clutch, and in the air phase the whelps pour out of them in packs.
The eggs are the entire reason she is in this swamp.
You are fighting a mother in the room she picked for it.

cards.subject: There is no trigger
lines: The line scrolls up your screen and somebody is screaming it into voice chat before the second word renders.
Blizzard were asked so many times that they answered officially.
It is entirely random.

cards.subject: Nobody accepted that answer
cards.tag: A wiki page that is a joke page
lines: The factors "empirically proven" to affect it: raid clumping, low damage, the raid leader's race and tone of voice, the number of gnomes present, whether the main tank was wearing pants.
It exists because "it's random" was never emotionally acceptable to anyone who had wiped to it.

cards.subject: They wrote a line for the exploit
lines: There is a dedicated voice line for raids attempting to drag her away from the eggs.
"You seek to lure me from my clutch? You shall pay for your insolence!"

cards.subject: You carry the head home
lines: It drops, you take it to your capital, and it is mounted in the city.
Every player of your faction standing there gets the buff: a hundred and forty attack power, ten percent spell crit, five percent melee and ranged crit, two hours.
One raid, and the whole city is stronger.

cards.subject: His face moves, once
lines: The quest text says his stoic demeanour changes for a split second when he sees it — "the mighty Doomhammer was nearly unsheathed."
"This is a great victory for the Horde. So many times you have honored your Warchief. It is time for the Warchief to honor you."

cards.subject: The other reply is personal
lines: "For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of Stormwind restored!"
Somebody she charmed in person is the one who thanks you for it.
